home.seo_title: Riband — Wedding & Portrait Photographer in Erbil
home.seo_desc: Riband Saadallah photographs weddings, portraits and schools in Erbil. Twelve years of Finnish street photography behind a timeless black-and-white signature.
home.hero_lead: Twelve years photographing the streets of Helsinki taught me patience, honesty, and shadow. I bring that eye to weddings and portraits in Erbil — quiet, deliberate, made to last.

services.title: Weddings
services.text: One wedding at a time, photographed like a story — unposed, unhurried, edited to last. In colour, and in the black-and-white signature.

services.title: Portraits
services.text: Individuals, couples, and families — in the studio, on the street, or in the light you love. Portraits with weight.

services.title: Schools
services.text: A yearly photography programme for schools in Erbil — class groups, individual portraits, and simple ordering for parents.
services.alt: School photography programme in Erbil — placeholder

home.band_quote: Colour shows how it looked. Black and white shows how it felt.
home.about_text: Finland taught me to wait for the light, respect the quiet, and keep only what is true. I came home to photograph Erbil the same way — honestly, beautifully, without noise.
home.cta_text: Dates go to whoever confirms first — autumn weekends leave earliest. Tell me about your day, and I'll tell you honestly if I'm the right photographer for it.

weddings.seo_desc: Editorial wedding photography in Erbil and across Kurdistan by Riband Saadallah. Documentary coverage in colour and a signature black-and-white edit. Collections from $650.
weddings.lead: Most wedding photography shouts — posed, loud, over-lit. Yours can whisper and still be unforgettable: the day as it truly happened, in rich colour and in the black-and-white signature I'm known for.
weddings.intro_img_alt: Wedding photography in Erbil by Riband — placeholder
weddings.approach_h2: Present everywhere. In the way, never.

steps.title: We meet
steps.text: A short call or coffee. We walk through the day, the venues, the people who matter most, and what you want to remember.

steps.title: I disappear into the day
steps.text: No staged interruptions, no shouting for lineups. I work quietly through the henna, the ceremony, the dancing — and the moments in between.

steps.title: You receive the story
steps.text: A curated private gallery in full colour and signature black and white — with albums and prints made to be passed down.

weddings.pkg_h2: Three ways to keep the day
weddings.pkg_note: Starting prices — every wedding is scoped personally in a short call, depending on date, venues, and hours. One wedding per date, always.

faq.q: How far in advance should we book?
faq.a: Three to six months for most dates. Autumn weekends in Erbil go first — if your date is set, ask early. I photograph one wedding per date, never two.

faq.q: Do you photograph in colour or only black and white?
faq.a: Both, always. You receive the full story in colour, plus a curated black-and-white edit — the signature. You never have to choose.
Yes — all of Kurdistan and Iraq, and internationally on request. Travel outside Erbil is quoted simply and agreed before booking.

faq.q: When do we see the photographs?
faq.a: A small preview within 48 hours — something to share while the day is still warm. The full gallery is delivered within three weeks.

faq.q: Can our families access the gallery?
faq.a: Yes. Your private gallery has a simple link and code you can share with family and guests, who can view and order prints themselves.

weddings.cta_text: A date, a venue, what you have in mind — that's enough to start.

portraits.seo_desc: Portrait sessions in Erbil by Riband Saadallah — individuals, couples, and families, in studio or on location. Sessions from $90, in colour and black and white.
portraits.lead: A portrait should say something true. In the studio or in the streets of Erbil, we make photographs you will still recognise yourself in, decades from now.
portraits.pkg_note: Starting prices. Hair, make-up, and printed portraits can be arranged — ask when booking.
portraits.note_text: Engagement sessions, graduations, private events, and editorial commissions are quoted individually — usually within a day. If it matters to you, it can be photographed properly.

schools.seo_desc: An organised annual photography programme for schools in Erbil: class groups and individual portraits, private galleries, and simple ordering for parents. Zero admin for staff.
schools.lead: A calm, organised picture day — every class, every student — with portraits parents actually want to buy. One agreement, zero admin for your staff.

steps.title: We schedule
steps.text: One planning meeting. We map the day around your timetable — grade by grade, class by class — and send a simple notice for parents.

steps.title: Picture day
steps.text: Class group photographs and individual portraits, taken quickly and kindly. A calm set, no chaos in the corridors, no lost lesson time.

steps.title: Parents order
steps.text: Each family receives a private gallery code. They order prints and digital packages directly — delivered back to the school, sorted by class.

schools.parents_h2: Simple for parents, private by design
schools.parents_text: Galleries are private per student — no public albums, ever. Parents view at home, choose what they love, and pay only for what they order. Photographs of students who don't participate are never taken in the first place.
schools.why_text: Picture day is led by an internationally published photographer, not a production line. The portrait your students take home should be worth framing — that is the entire point of the programme.
schools.pricing_h2: What it costs the school: nothing
schools.pricing_text: The programme is free for the school. Parents buy only what they love — packages start from $10. Schools receive the class group photographs for their own archive, every year.

faq.q: What does the programme cost the school?
faq.a: Nothing. The school provides a room and the timetable; we handle everything else. Parents order only what they want.
Directly to us — cash on delivery to the school, or by card/transfer where available. The school never handles money.

faq.q: What about absent students or retakes?
faq.a: A short retake session is included in every programme, so absent students and unlucky blinks get a second chance.
Each student's portraits live behind a private code shared only with their family. Nothing is published, and files are stored securely and deleted on an agreed schedule.

schools.cta_text: Autumn dates are limited — the earlier in the term, the better the calendar.

work.seo_desc: Selected photographs by Riband Saadallah — weddings and portraits in Erbil, and twelve years of black-and-white street photography from Helsinki to Cambodia.
work.lead: Weddings, portraits, and the street photography that shaped the eye. Black and white first — colour when the story needs it.

about.seo_desc: Riband Saadallah spent twelve years photographing in Finland — black-and-white street photography, editorial work, and model photography — before coming home to Erbil.
about.p1: I learned photography where light is scarce. Twelve years in Finland — Helsinki, Espoo — taught me to wait for it, to work with shadow instead of fighting it, and to keep only the honest frame.
about.p2: My black-and-white street photography at @bnwlives is followed by thousands. I've served as editor-in-chief of Gilkend, photographed for Suomi Models in Finland, and carried a camera from Rome to Cambodia.
about.p3: Now I'm home. Riband is the studio I'm building in Erbil — for weddings, portraits, and the city's schools — Nordic restraint, in service of Kurdish celebration.
about.quote: Black and white is not a filter. It is a way of seeing.
about.sig_text: Every commission is delivered in full colour and in a curated monochrome edit. Colour records the day; black and white keeps the feeling. Fifty years from now, the monochrome frames are the ones on the wall.

contact.seo_desc: Book wedding, portrait, or school photography in Erbil. WhatsApp Riband directly or book a consultation call — replies within one working day.
contact.lead: WhatsApp is fastest. Or pick a time below and we'll talk it through properly.
